# Worldant AI Entrypoint

Read [`ai/worldant.llms.txt`](ai/worldant.llms.txt) first. It is the canonical AI documentation for
Worldant.

Use [`ai/llms-full.txt`](ai/llms-full.txt) when a larger context window is available.

Core invariants:

- Commands and Workflows are the public callable concepts.
- Steps are internal Workflow checkpoints and are never public callables.
- Query, Mutation, Reactive/Rule, Goal, and generic Action are not current concepts.
- Authentication is bring-your-own. Worldant exposes custom request headers to PostgreSQL as
  transaction-local `request.headers`.
- App authorization is normal PostgreSQL row-level security in migrations.
